notes.title: Nefarious Patreon
notes.content:
Nefarious Patreon

Bad Guy's Gonna Win

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24766533/bdf44f468c7a3b43c70515cf160926d8ff937de0.png

We wanted to make our steam community aware of the Nefarious Patreon
The graphic novel that continues the story of the game is available for reading now. Volume 1 "Bad Guy's Gonna Win" was a kickstarted graphic novel; Crow has taken to freelance where he specializes in helping other Bad Guy's win for a change. It sees the return of many fan favorites, including a few new princesses and villains. 

Death by Paperwork

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24766533/8cbf83db558d141f7eb9922563d9c5265448798e.png

The Patreon is also home to the exclusive comic Death by Paperwork
starring Becky, secretary of evil, as she navigates the politics and perils of running Crow's empire while he's out kidnapping princesses.

Make a pledge today and catch up on all the adventure.

Nefarious Patreon

notes.content:

Quick fixes: Achievement detection fixed and trippers for them added to the Sovereign.

Rebinding issues fixed - up and down are no longer rebindable controls, as they are never used outside of a menu context.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 The Mac/Linux Edition!
notes.content:
Patch 1.1

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24766533/16e60cecbcd681110597fe93fcc50f624e37a69b.png

Features  

- Mac(k) Version: Nefarious is now available to play on macs! 

- Linux Version: Nefarious will also play on Linux.  

- Options Enabled: We now have a options menu on the main screen! With it comes a host of other features.  

* Button remapping:Players can now remap most buttons and create a custom set up.

* Windowed Mode: Window mode can be toggled on or off. 

 * Resolution: Players can now change the camera resolution. 

- New defeated effects for kicking hero butt. 

- Overhauled SFX for the following encounters 

 * Dr. Mechano's battle 

 * Insektia Reverse Boss Battle 

 * Winterdown Reverse Boss Battle 

 * Adept Co. Reverse Boss Battle 

 Bug Fixes 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24766533/56140dd6144d6c0e5e285c87ee340473b2b98de2.png

- Fixed an issue that sometimes caused Crow to fall through the world while punching cars. 

- Fixed an issue where Crow could be killed by the care package, and not advance.

- Fixed an issue that caused the Macro City elevator to leave without Crow. 

- Players should no longer be able to take Prince Malachite's power up outside of his stage. Malachite? More like Mala-cheat. Amirite?

- Fixed an issue where the royalty would sometimes not load when re-opening the game. 

- Bramble Flats should now properly unlock S-ranks for beating it under 6-minutes. 

- The King Crow Achievement should now properly unlock. 

- Fixed a graphical glitch that sometimes made textures not load when locking windows. 

- Fixed issue where certain triggered cutscenes would autoscroll on the Sovereign.

notes.title: Nefarious - Available Now!
notes.content:
Nefarious is now available
The fated day has finally arrived! Nefarious is available now on steam. It's been a wonderful journey from concept, to kickstarter to completion. I hope you all enjoy the game as much as I've enjoyed working on it.

FAQ

Will there be a mac/linux version?
Yes, we're currently working on getting those in next. We'll release another update when we have more information available.

I saw this once had local versus mode. Is that still in the game?
The current version does not have "villain ball" activated, but it is something we're working on as a future free update.

I found a bug! What do I do?
Please forward all bugs to nefariousbugs@gmail.com and we'll try and get them squashed in a future update! Also include your output log, which can be located in your Nefarious Data folder. \steamapps\common\Nefarious\Nefarious_Data\output_log.txt

notes.title: Coming Soon! January 23rd!
notes.content:
Coming Soon! January 23rd

Wanted to give another shout out. As we wrap up everything we need for our 1.0 build of Nefarious. As I write this update we're putting the final touches on the ending sequence (all of them) to give our players  an awesome send off once they complete the game. We're on track for our monday release, and I can't wait.

Reverse Boss Fight Trailer

We also wanted to share our reverse boss fight trailer with out steam community. Check it out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sfsDhfvfdMI

We'll see you monday. And we're looking forward to hearing what you think of  Nefarious.
